faq.question: Which areas do you serve?
faq.answer: We install purifiers and make AMC visits in Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Noida Extension, Gurugram, and Faridabad.

faq.question: Do you offer AMC?
faq.answer: Yes. Half-yearly and yearly plans cover servicing, filter and membrane replacement, and repairs. Prices are not listed here yet — message us on WhatsApp and we’ll follow up.

faq.question: How do I choose between RO, UV, and UF?
faq.answer: Most Auliv models are RO purifiers, and many home units also include UV and UF. Elixir 1 and Elixir 2 are UV+UF purifiers for low-TDS municipal water. Tell us your water source on WhatsApp and we’ll suggest a model.

faq.question: Which purifiers include alkaline or copper?
faq.answer: Sapphire and Elegant add alkaline and copper purification. Grand Plus, Crown Plus, and Marvel Plus add copper, along with RO and UV or UF. Ask on WhatsApp if you want one of those stages.

faq.question: How do I get a quote?
faq.answer: Call or WhatsApp +91 8368879809, Monday to Saturday. Tell us the model, or ask for a recommendation for your home or workplace. We’ll confirm the price, installation, and AMC with you. There is no online store.
